alerts.title: Research: BB raised outlook after record QNX quarter
alerts.summary: BlackBerry reported 26% year-over-year revenue growth, 81% adjusted EBITDA growth, positive operating cash flow and raised FY2027 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance. This is a credible post-earnings continuation catalyst, but no paper option entry is permitted until the market reopens and the exact contract, price action, IV, Greeks, spread, OI and buyer-initiated flow are verified.
reasons: Q2 FY2027 revenue increased 26% year over year to $163.3 million.
Adjusted EBITDA increased 81% year over year and operating cash flow was $29.3 million.
QNX secured its largest design win to date, adding more than $100 million to royalty backlog.
Management raised full-year revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook.

alerts.title: Research: FTHM proposed digital-asset restructuring
alerts.summary: Fathom and Neighborhood Intelligence disclosed a proposed alternative transaction that would place substantially all of NXH's digital-asset holdings into Fathom, including an approximately 38.8% direct and indirect interest in tZERO, Medici-related fund assets and GrainChain. The companies describe at least $130 million of contributed-asset value, subject to Fathom validation and definitive agreements. This is research only: the market is closed and entry eligibility cannot be established without a fresh quote, volume/structure confirmation and updated dilution-risk checks.
reasons: The September 24 Form 8-K confirms the parties agreed to explore an alternative structure replacing the previously announced merger structure.
The issuer release says NXH would contribute its approximately 38.8% direct and indirect tZERO interest, Medici-related assets and GrainChain investment.
The proposed contributed assets are described as worth no less than $130 million, subject to due diligence and definitive documentation.
The catalyst is recent, issuer-confirmed and potentially material relative to a microcap issuer, but remains preliminary.

FTHM also received an August 21 Nasdaq minimum-bid deficiency notice with a February 17, 2027 compliance deadline.
